# Expected values for the materials that reach a building site (docs/rules/construction-materials.md), captured from the original
# program in the emulator (ADR 0008): tools/GhidraDump/emulate.py, the verb construct, which is remove with the phase routine 0x42965c at
# the last phase of each cycle (the castle's goods go out to the requests) and, for the player setup, the default words 0x445752. The
# click b@x,y,T places the site of the type T, and l@x,y,H sets the heights of the node and its six neighbours to H (the ground a digger
# leaves a large site, which the building pass tests before it asks for materials).
# The lines are the emulator's output reduced to what the engine reproduces: the flag items f<slot> (70 bytes, the request words at 0x42
# to 0x45), the building items b<slot> (18 bytes: the status at 5, the fill bytes at 8 and 9, the progress word at 12), and the storage
# item st (the stock word of good g at 4 + 2 * g). The flag and building slots are one higher than the engine's (the dummies of the tables).
# The engine hands a good out by laying it on the castle's flag at once, where the original's first settler carries it out and lays it there
# about 130 passes later, and the original's storage keeps two goods at most outstanding (+0x3a, +0x3b), which the engine does not model;
# the engine runs no builder yet (the builder of slice 03 reaches the site at pass 211). So the checks cover the passes up to the
# first hand-out's carrying (the passes the fixture lists), and the rank of a site's request until the builder arrives.
# Not production code: no routine of the program is transcribed here, only values the program produced.
